name: nf_scientific_synonyms
description: Scientific analyzer for NF free-text discovery fields: standard tokenizer + lowercase + english stopwords + english stemmer. Search-time (default_search) additionally applies the org.synapse.nf 'standard_synonyms' synonym_graph (e.g. nf->neurofibromatosis, mpnst->malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, pnf->plexiform neurofibroma) so abbreviation/alias queries expand at query time only. The synonym_graph filter is preceded only by 'lowercase' on purpose: OpenSearch parses each synonym definition through the preceding filters, and graph filters such as word_delimiter_graph are rejected there (that splitting is instead handled by the IDENTIFIER analyzer on the id columns). synonym_graph is search-time-only because multi-word synonyms can't be safely flattened at index time.
